response.content:
The permutation fixes 1 and swaps adjacent pairs \((2,3),(4,5),(6,7),\dots\). Thus even \(n\ge2\) maps to \(n+1\), and odd \(n\ge3\) maps to \(n-1\). Applying this to 63–72 gives \([62,65,64,67,66,69,68,71,70,73]\), which is choice H.

Answer: H
